payload.title: Graph neighbourhood component
payload.description:
As a reader, I want to see what an entity is connected to, so that I can navigate by relation.

Columns by relation type (for example made by, built on, measured by, replaces) with weight bars where weight is the number of items linking both ends. Reads the entity JSON from the snapshot. Relation types are publication data.

```gherkin
Feature: Graph neighbourhood
  Scenario: Render columns
    Given an entity with relations of two types
    Then the component renders one column per type with entries ordered by weight

  Scenario: Only desk-confirmed relations
    Then relations not confirmed by the desk are not shown
```
